readback: When a member makes a Spend within 7 days before or after their birthday, they get the 'Complimentary Voucher Codes' privilege (ID 64). They can get it once per birthday, so once a year.
assumptions: 'Within 7 days of their birthday' is read as 7 days before through 7 days after the birthday.
'A spend' is read as the activity type SPEND (Spend), not PURCHASE (Shopping).
'Complimentary voucher' is read as privilege 64 'Complimentary Voucher Codes', not 63 'COmplimentry'.
'Once a year' comes from the occasion reward, which is given once per birthday. No other usage limit or frequency is set.
The birthday is taken from the member attribute date_of_birth for this draft.
Any spend amount counts, because no minimum was given.
No start or end date was given, so the offer runs indefinitely.
blocking_questions: Two member attributes could hold the birthday: 'Date of Birth' (date_of_birth) and 'birthday date' (birthday_date). Which one should be used? The draft uses date_of_birth.
